name: automate
title: Automation - CI, hooks and scripts, verified locally
titleAr: أتمتة — CI وhooks وسكربتات، متأكد منها محليًا
description: Builds or fixes developer automation: CI/CD workflows, pre-commit hooks, release or maintenance scripts, scheduled jobs. Commands are verified against the real project first, workflows follow least-privilege and supply-chain rules, and every job's commands are proven locally before anything ships.

stages.title: Automation landscape
stages.prompt:
Automation goal: {TASK}

Project root: {PROJECT}. Inventory existing automation: CI workflows (.github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml, azure-pipelines.yml, Jenkinsfile), hooks (.husky, .pre-commit-config.yaml, lefthook), task runners (package.json scripts, Makefile, justfile, Taskfile), Dockerfiles and scripts/. Record the real install/build/lint/test commands verified against the manifests, the runtime versions the project pins (engines, .nvmrc, .python-version, go.mod, rust-toolchain), environment variables and secret NAMES referenced (never values), and the target operating systems. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
done: analysis.md lists existing automation files with citations, or states none exist
analysis.md gives the verified install/build/lint/test commands and pinned runtime versions
analysis.md names referenced secrets and environment variables by name only

stages.title: Automation design
stages.prompt:
Automation goal: {TASK}

Grounding: .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md (project {PROJECT}). Produce the plan per your role contract: triggers, jobs and steps, caching, matrix and failure notification. Apply these rules and state how each is met: least-privilege `permissions`; third-party actions pinned to a full commit SHA or exact version; no secrets echoed to logs; no untrusted `${{ github.event.* }}` interpolated into shell; `pull_request_target` avoided unless justified; concurrency cancellation for superseded runs; idempotent, cross-platform scripts where the team needs them. Name the local verification for every artifact (for example actionlint, shellcheck, `act -n` if installed, running each job's commands directly). Write it to .workbench/artifacts/plan.md.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the automation design in plan.md - build it?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع تصميم الأتمتة في plan.md — نبنيه؟
done: plan.md exists and contains all required sections (Task, Requirements, Chosen approach, Steps, Acceptance criteria, Risks)
plan.md states how each security rule (permissions, pinning, secrets, injection) is met
Every automation artifact has a named local verification command

stages.title: Build the automation
stages.prompt: Implement the automation in .workbench/artifacts/plan.md for the project at {PROJECT}. Reuse the project's existing commands instead of re-implementing them, keep every job runnable locally, and add no dependency the plan does not approve. Run each local verification command from the plan and record its output. Write code-notes.md per your role contract.
done: Every plan step is implemented or its omission is explicitly justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md records the output of each local verification command from the plan

stages.title: Verify the automation
stages.prompt: Verify the automation change in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Validate workflow and script syntax with the validators available (actionlint, shellcheck, yamllint, `act -n`) and mark unavailable validators NOT TESTABLE instead of skipping silently; run each job's underlying commands locally; run every new script twice to prove it is idempotent; audit the workflows against the plan's security rules (permissions, pinning, secret handling, script injection). Write review.md per your role contract and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
review.md lists each validator with its result or NOT TESTABLE
review.md confirms each job's commands ran locally and each security rule is met

stages.title: Fix the automation
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL for the automation in the project at {PROJECT} (details in .workbench/artifacts/review.md). Reproduce each failure locally first, fix root causes only, and never weaken a security rule or delete a check to get green. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is addressed or refuted with evidence
debug.md shows the failing output before and the passing output after

stages.title: Ship the automation
stages.prompt: The automation PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. List every secret or repository setting the user must configure under Follow-ups. Write ship.md.
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
ship.md lists required secrets or repository settings under Follow-ups, or states none are needed
